title: Split an amount without losing cents
prompt: splitAmount(cents, n) in money.js should split an integer amount of cents into n integer parts that add up to exactly cents and differ by at most one, with the larger parts (in absolute value) first: splitAmount(100, 3) is [34, 33, 33] and splitAmount(-100, 3) is [-34, -33, -33]. It currently loses or invents cents. Fix it; n that is not a positive integer, or cents that is not an integer, throws a RangeError. Do not change test.js.
